summary: V1 Guided Play Mode - Streak integration with CoachPlay tested. Fixed critical bug where PreGameStreakPopup was not rendering on setup screen (early return issue). All 5 features verified working: page loads, streak data fetched, pre-move checklist with weaknesses, pre-game popup, post-game result.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Streak integration with CoachPlay fully working. Key fix: PreGameStreakPopup was not rendering because it was placed after the early return for setup screen. Fixed by adding the popup component inside the setup screen's Layout. All streak features verified: 1) Streak data fetched on page load via /api/streak/status, 2) Focus mistake mapped to player weaknesses in pre-move checklist (THREAT_VERIFICATION -> hope_chess -> 'What will my opponent do after this move?'), 3) Pre-game popup shows with rule reminder before game starts, 4) Post-game streak result shows after resign with 'Streak Broken' message.

pregame_popup_not_rendering.issue: PreGameStreakPopup was placed after the main game UI return statement, so it never rendered when on setup screen (early return at line 1793)
pregame_popup_not_rendering.fix: Added PreGameStreakPopup component inside the setup screen's Layout component (before the closing </Layout> tag)

1_page_loads.verified: CoachPlay page loads with setup screen showing color selection, time control, coaching style options

2_streak_data_fetched.verified: Streak API called on page load, returns focus_mistake_type, rule, current_streak, best_streak

verified: Checklist visible during game with 'Before You Move' header
Focus mistake mapped to weakness: THREAT_VERIFICATION -> hope_chess
Shows 'What will my opponent do after this move?' with Focus badge
Shows 'You tend to play moves without considering opponent responses' explanation
Additional checklist items: development check, center control

mocked_apis_list: POST /api/streak/update uses mock move_evaluations from session.move_history - in production should come from full Stockfish analysis
